# Stella Maynard

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c36 P20](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0020)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c36 P21](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

Stella is described as a vivid, black-eyed girl of noticeable beauty.

_Sources: [v1 c36 P20](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0020)_

## Personality

She is a wistful, dream-filled young woman with a charming disposition.

_Sources: [v1 c36 P20](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0020)_

## History

Stella Maynard attended Queen's Academy alongside Anne Shirley and her circle of classmates. During her time at the Academy, she developed an exceptionally close friendship with Anne.

_Sources: [v1 c36 P20](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0020), [v1 c36 P21](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0021)_

## Affiliations

- Queen's Academy — Student  <sub>[v1 c36 P20](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0020)</sub>

## Relationships

### Anne Shirley

- Friend of — Stella is one of Anne's dearest friends at Queen's Academy.  <sub>[v1 c36 P20](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0020), [v1 c36 P21](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0021)</sub>
